dataset_name: Central Water Commission (CWC) & Assam SDMA Historical Major Flood Events
provider: Central Water Commission (CWC) / Assam State Disaster Management Authority (ASDMA) / JRC
spatial_resolution: District and river reach level polygons/points
ner_coverage: Brahmaputra Valley (Kaziranga, Majuli, Barpeta, Dhemaji) & Barak Basin (Silchar, Cachar)
use_in_system: Historical flood hazard validation, seasonal inundation recurrence, and multi-hazard assessment
known_limitations: Embankment breach locations documented primarily in Brahmaputra and Barak river basins
